question: Related Questions Q. A 19 yr old girl would like to start memorizing the quraan. however her family are against the idea as they think she is of marriagable age and after getting married may forget the quraan due to becoming busy in her new life. Is there any special ruling in islam for females memorizing the quraan? and would it be advisable for her to start? 3437 views Q. Alhamdullillah I try to do one para daur daily (in about an hour) and try to finish it again in my salaah. To learn the daur I first read the first 2 pages from the Quraan then I recite it by heart, I continue like this till I have completed the whole para. Then if my mind does not feel too tired, I read the whole para again from memory, thereafter I do my sabak daur. This is the method that I have devised but I wanted to know the proper method of learning daur as Huffaz do in the Madaaris. A student told me that I can learn ruku by ruku, this does not seem so appropriete for me as sometimes the ruku is too short and sometimes too long. 2. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 167874 Country: India Title: Is taking salary for teaching Quran is lawful? Question: 1. Is taking salary for teaching Quran is lawful? 2. In madaris all type of people (earnings from halal and haram) give zakah and it is used for students in madaris without inquiry, is it lawful? Answer ID: 167874 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 598/494/B=05/1440) The later Fuqha have allowed taking fee on teaching the Holy Quran for Shariah needs, so it is lawful to receive fee for teaching the Holy Quran. ويفتى الیوم بصحتها لتعليم القرآن والفقه والإمامة والأذان وفي رد المحتار: قال في الهداية: وبعض مشايخنا رحمهم الله استحسنوا الاستئجار على تعليم القرآن اليوم لظهور التواني في الأمور الدينية ففى الامتناع تضييع حفظ القرآن وعليه الفتوى (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار، كتاب الإجارة، باب الإجارة الفاسده، 9/ 76، ط: زكريا) (2) If you know for sure that the zakah of so and so person is from haram wealth then it is not lawful to take zakah from him and if you are not sure then there is no need to investigate it thoroughly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
